The '''Malor-77 system''' was located in the [[Bri'ahl sector/Legends|Bri'ahl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]].
